doc.md:
Switches between children using tabs.

There are many configuration options for `GtkNotebook`. Among
other things, you can choose on which edge the tabs appear
(see [`Notebook.set_tab_pos()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Notebook#method:set_tab_pos)), whether, if there are
too many tabs to fit the notebook should be made bigger or scrolling
arrows added (see [`Notebook.set_scrollable()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Notebook#method:set_scrollable)), and whether
there will be a popup menu allowing the users to switch pages.
(see [`Notebook.popup_enable()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Notebook#method:popup_enable)).

# GtkNotebook as GtkBuildable

The `GtkNotebook` implementation of the `GtkBuildable` interface
supports placing children into tabs by specifying “tab” as the
“type” attribute of a `<child>` element. Note that the content
of the tab must be created before the tab can be filled.
A tab child can be specified without specifying a `<child>`
type attribute.

To add a child widget in the notebooks action area, specify
"action-start" or “action-end” as the “type” attribute of the
`<child>` element.

An example of a UI definition fragment with `GtkNotebook`:

```xml
<object class="GtkNotebook">
  <child>
    <object class="GtkLabel" id="notebook-content">
      <property name="label">Content</property>
    </object>
  </child>
  <child type="tab">
    <object class="GtkLabel" id="notebook-tab">
      <property name="label">Tab</property>
    </object>
  </child>
</object>
```

# Shortcuts and Gestures

`GtkNotebook` supports the following keyboard shortcuts:

- <kbd>Shift</kbd>+<kbd>F10</kbd> or <kbd>Menu</kbd> opens the context menu.
- <kbd>Home</kbd> moves the focus to the first tab.
- <kbd>End</kbd> moves the focus to the last tab.

Additionally, the following signals have default keybindings:

- [`Notebook::change-current-page`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Notebook#event:change-current-page)
- [`Notebook::focus-tab`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Notebook#event:focus-tab)
- [`Notebook::move-focus-out`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Notebook#event:move-focus-out)
- [`Notebook::reorder-tab`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Notebook#event:reorder-tab)
- [`Notebook::select-page`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Notebook#event:select-page)

Tabs support drag-and-drop between notebooks sharing the same `group-name`,
or to new windows by handling the `::create-window` signal.

# Actions

`GtkNotebook` defines a set of built-in actions:

- `menu.popup` opens the tabs context menu.

# CSS nodes

```
notebook
├── header.top
│   ├── [<action widget>]
│   ├── tabs
│   │   ├── [arrow]
│   │   ├── tab
│   │   │   ╰── <tab label>
┊   ┊   ┊
│   │   ├── tab[.reorderable-page]
│   │   │   ╰── <tab label>
│   │   ╰── [arrow]
│   ╰── [<action widget>]
│
╰── stack
    ├── <child>
    ┊
    ╰── <child>
```

`GtkNotebook` has a main CSS node with name `notebook`, a subnode
with name `header` and below that a subnode with name `tabs` which
contains one subnode per tab with name `tab`.

If action widgets are present, their CSS nodes are placed next
to the `tabs` node. If the notebook is scrollable, CSS nodes with
name `arrow` are placed as first and last child of the `tabs` node.

The main node gets the `.frame` style class when the notebook
has a border (see [`Notebook.set_show_border()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Notebook#method:set_show_border)).

The header node gets one of the style class `.top`, `.bottom`,
`.left` or `.right`, depending on where the tabs are placed. For
reorderable pages, the tab node gets the `.reorderable-page` class.

A `tab` node gets the `.dnd` style class while it is moved with drag-and-drop.

The nodes are always arranged from left-to-right, regardless of text direction.

# Accessibility

`GtkNotebook` uses the following roles:

 - [`AccessibleRole.group`](xref:gtk:Gtk.AccessibleRole#value:group) for the notebook widget
 - [`AccessibleRole.tab_list`](xref:gtk:Gtk.AccessibleRole#value:tab_list) for the list of tabs
 - [`AccessibleRole.tab`](xref:gtk:Gtk.AccessibleRole#value:tab) role for each tab
 - [`AccessibleRole.tab_panel`](xref:gtk:Gtk.AccessibleRole#value:tab_panel) for each page

append_page_menu.brief: Appends a page to `notebook`, specifying the widget to use as the label in the popup menu.
append_page_menu.md:
Appends a page to `notebook`, specifying the widget to use as the
label in the popup menu.

detach_tab.brief: Removes the child from the notebook.
detach_tab.md:
Removes the child from the notebook.

This function is very similar to [`Notebook.remove_page()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Notebook#method:remove_page),
but additionally informs the notebook that the removal
is happening as part of a tab DND operation, which should
not be cancelled.

get_action_widget.brief: Gets one of the action widgets.
get_action_widget.md:
Gets one of the action widgets.

See [`Notebook.set_action_widget()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Notebook#method:set_action_widget).

get_current_page.brief: Returns the page number of the current page.
get_current_page.md: Returns the page number of the current page.

get_group_name.brief: Gets the current group name for `notebook`.
get_group_name.md: Gets the current group name for `notebook`.

get_menu_label.brief: Retrieves the menu label widget of the page containing `child`.
get_menu_label.md: Retrieves the menu label widget of the page containing `child`.

get_menu_label_text.brief: Retrieves the text of the menu label for the page containing `child`.
get_menu_label_text.md:
Retrieves the text of the menu label for the page containing
`child`.

get_n_pages.brief: Gets the number of pages in a notebook.
get_n_pages.md: Gets the number of pages in a notebook.

get_nth_page.brief: Returns the child widget contained in page number `page_num`.
get_nth_page.md: Returns the child widget contained in page number `page_num`.

get_pages.brief: Returns a `GListModel` that contains the pages of the notebook.
get_pages.md:
Returns a `GListModel` that contains the pages of the notebook.

This can be used to keep an up-to-date view. The model also
implements [`SelectionModel`](xref:gtk:Gtk.SelectionModel) and can be used to track
and modify the visible page.

get_scrollable.brief: Returns whether the tab label area has arrows for scrolling.
get_scrollable.md: Returns whether the tab label area has arrows for scrolling.

get_show_border.brief: Returns whether a bevel will be drawn around the notebook pages.
get_show_border.md: Returns whether a bevel will be drawn around the notebook pages.

get_show_tabs.brief: Returns whether the tabs of the notebook are shown.
get_show_tabs.md: Returns whether the tabs of the notebook are shown.

get_tab_detachable.brief: Returns whether the tab contents can be detached from `notebook`.
get_tab_detachable.md: Returns whether the tab contents can be detached from `notebook`.

get_tab_label.brief: Returns the tab label widget for the page `child`.
get_tab_label.md:
Returns the tab label widget for the page `child`.

`NULL` is returned if `child` is not in `notebook` or
if no tab label has specifically been set for `child`.

get_tab_label_text.brief: Retrieves the text of the tab label for the page containing `child`.
get_tab_label_text.md:
Retrieves the text of the tab label for the page containing
`child`.

get_tab_pos.brief: Gets the edge at which the tabs are drawn.
get_tab_pos.md: Gets the edge at which the tabs are drawn.

get_tab_reorderable.brief: Gets whether the tab can be reordered via drag and drop or not.
get_tab_reorderable.md: Gets whether the tab can be reordered via drag and drop or not.

insert_page.brief: Insert a page into `notebook` at the given position.
insert_page.md: Insert a page into `notebook` at the given position.

insert_page_menu.brief: Insert a page into `notebook` at the given position, specifying the widget to use as the label in the popup menu.
insert_page_menu.md:
Insert a page into `notebook` at the given position, specifying
the widget to use as the label in the popup menu.

next_page.md:
Switches to the next page.

Nothing happens if the current page is the last page.

page_num.brief: Finds the index of the page which contains the given child widget.
page_num.md:
Finds the index of the page which contains the given child
widget.

popup_enable.md:
Enables the popup menu.

If the user clicks with the right mouse button on the tab labels,
a menu with all the pages will be popped up.

prepend_page_menu.brief: Prepends a page to `notebook`, specifying the widget to use as the label in the popup menu.
prepend_page_menu.md:
Prepends a page to `notebook`, specifying the widget to use as the
label in the popup menu.

prev_page.md:
Switches to the previous page.

Nothing happens if the current page is the first page.

remove_page.brief: Removes a page from the notebook given its index in the notebook.
remove_page.md:
Removes a page from the notebook given its index
in the notebook.

reorder_child.brief: Reorders the page containing `child`, so that it appears in position `position`.
reorder_child.md:
Reorders the page containing `child`, so that it appears in position
`position`.

If `position` is greater than or equal to the number of children in
the list or negative, `child` will be moved to the end of the list.

set_action_widget.brief: Sets `widget` as one of the action widgets.
set_action_widget.md:
Sets `widget` as one of the action widgets.

Depending on the pack type the widget will be placed before
or after the tabs. You can use a `GtkBox` if you need to pack
more than one widget on the same side.

set_current_page.md:
Switches to the page number `page_num`.

Note that due to historical reasons, GtkNotebook refuses
to switch to a page unless the child widget is visible.
Therefore, it is recommended to show child widgets before
adding them to a notebook.

set_group_name.md:
Sets a group name for `notebook`.

Notebooks with the same name will be able to exchange tabs
via drag and drop. A notebook with a `NULL` group name will
not be able to exchange tabs with any other notebook.

set_menu_label.brief: Changes the menu label for the page containing `child`.
set_menu_label.md: Changes the menu label for the page containing `child`.

set_menu_label_text.brief: Creates a new label and sets it as the menu label of `child`.
set_menu_label_text.md: Creates a new label and sets it as the menu label of `child`.

set_scrollable.brief: Sets whether the tab label area will have arrows for scrolling if there are too many tabs to fit in the area.
set_scrollable.md:
Sets whether the tab label area will have arrows for
scrolling if there are too many tabs to fit in the area.

set_show_border.brief: Sets whether a bevel will be drawn around the notebook pages.
set_show_border.md:
Sets whether a bevel will be drawn around the notebook pages.

This only has a visual effect when the tabs are not shown.

set_show_tabs.brief: Sets whether to show the tabs for the notebook or not.
set_show_tabs.md: Sets whether to show the tabs for the notebook or not.

set_tab_detachable.brief: Sets whether the tab can be detached from `notebook` to another notebook or widget.

set_tab_label.md:
Changes the tab label for `child`.

If `NULL` is specified for `tab_label`, then the page will
have the label “page N”.

set_tab_label_text.brief: Creates a new label and sets it as the tab label for the page containing `child`.
set_tab_label_text.md:
Creates a new label and sets it as the tab label for the page
containing `child`.

set_tab_pos.brief: Sets the edge at which the tabs are drawn.
set_tab_pos.md: Sets the edge at which the tabs are drawn.

set_tab_reorderable.brief: Sets whether the notebook tab can be reordered via drag and drop or not.
set_tab_reorderable.md:
Sets whether the notebook tab can be reordered
via drag and drop or not.

enable-popup.brief: If `TRUE`, pressing the right mouse button on the notebook shows a page switching menu.
enable-popup.md: If `TRUE`, pressing the right mouse button on the notebook shows a page switching menu.

group-name.brief: Group name for tab drag and drop.
group-name.md: Group name for tab drag and drop.

page.brief: The index of the current page.
page.md: The index of the current page.

pages.brief: A selection model with the pages.
pages.md: A selection model with the pages.

scrollable.brief: If `TRUE`, scroll arrows are added if there are too many pages to fit.
scrollable.md: If `TRUE`, scroll arrows are added if there are too many pages to fit.

show-border.brief: Whether the border should be shown.
show-border.md: Whether the border should be shown.

tab-pos.brief: Which side of the notebook holds the tabs.
tab-pos.md: Which side of the notebook holds the tabs.

change-current-page.brief: Emitted when the current page should be changed.
change-current-page.md:
Emitted when the current page should be changed.

The default bindings for this signal are
<kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Alt</kbd>+<kbd>PgUp</kbd>,
<kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Alt</kbd>+<kbd>PgDn</kbd>,
<kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>PgUp</kbd> and <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>PgDn</kbd>.

create-window.brief: The ::create-window signal is emitted when a detachable tab is dropped on the root window.
create-window.md:
The ::create-window signal is emitted when a detachable
tab is dropped on the root window.

A handler for this signal can create a window containing
a notebook where the tab will be attached. It is also
responsible for moving/resizing the window and adding the
necessary properties to the notebook (e.g. the
`GtkNotebook`:group-name ).

focus-tab.brief: Emitted when a tab should be focused.
focus-tab.md: Emitted when a tab should be focused.

move-focus-out.brief: Emitted when focus was moved out.
move-focus-out.md:
Emitted when focus was moved out.

The default bindings for this signal are
<kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Tab</kbd>,
<kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Shift</kbd>+<kbd>Tab</kbd>,
<kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>←</kbd>, <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>→</kbd>,
<kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>↑</kbd> and <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>↓</kbd>.

page-added.brief: the ::page-added signal is emitted in the notebook right after a page is added to the notebook.
page-added.md:
the ::page-added signal is emitted in the notebook
right after a page is added to the notebook.

page-removed.brief: the ::page-removed signal is emitted in the notebook right after a page is removed from the notebook.
page-removed.md:
the ::page-removed signal is emitted in the notebook
right after a page is removed from the notebook.

page-reordered.brief: the ::page-reordered signal is emitted in the notebook right after a page has been reordered.
page-reordered.md:
the ::page-reordered signal is emitted in the notebook
right after a page has been reordered.

reorder-tab.brief: Emitted when the tab should be reordered.
reorder-tab.md:
Emitted when the tab should be reordered.

The default bindings for this signal are
<kbd>Alt</kbd>+<kbd>Home</kbd>, <kbd>Alt</kbd>+<kbd>End</kbd>,
<kbd>Alt</kbd>+<kbd>PgUp</kbd>, <kbd>Alt</kbd>+<kbd>PgDn</kbd>,
<kbd>Alt</kbd>+<kbd>←</kbd>, <kbd>Alt</kbd>+<kbd>→</kbd>,
<kbd>Alt</kbd>+<kbd>↑</kbd> and <kbd>Alt</kbd>+<kbd>↓</kbd>.

select-page.brief: Emitted when a page should be selected.
select-page.md:
Emitted when a page should be selected.

The default binding for this signal is <kbd>␣</kbd>.

switch-page.brief: Emitted when the user or a function changes the current page.
switch-page.md: Emitted when the user or a function changes the current page.
